About
The Examination Branch of the institute plays a pivotal role in upholding the academic integrity and conducting smooth and efficient examinations. Established with a vision to streamline the assessment process, the branch facilitates end-semester exams, internal assessments, and supplementary exams for both undergraduate and postgraduate programs.
Its services include scheduling of exams, preparation of question papers, result processing, issuing of grade cards, and handling of academic grievances. The branch ensures timely communication with departments and students, maintaining a transparent and systematic approach to examinations.
